reason: CLC is a real 1-byte, 2-cycle implied op; removing it saves 2 cycles on every path through steps_known with A != 0 (the BEQ walked path never ran it). C = 0 after the third ASL needs bit 5 of steps clear: every path checked. Unclipped movers: steps <= n <= sprite_column_count, and every sprite animation_table (values 00-2E,33-35,37-4B, no &32 or &36) or mover_types_third_sprite (09,0C,0E,20) can give has a count <= &0C; the two counts that would break it, &32 = &82 and &36 = &00 (n = 0 unflipped would give steps = d+1 up to 80), are in neither table. Clipped or overrun movers (n <= 0, X wrapping): mover_x_low = viewport_left_low and viewport_right_low - viewport_left_low is always &4F (set &FF/&B0 at reset, INC/DEC together), so steps = d+1 = &50, bit 5 = 0: still C = 0. walk_column has one caller (JSR at plot_mover_sprite). No other entry to the ADC; nothing writes or reads these bytes as data (grep: walked/c1_walk_high_kept/screen_in_range referenced only here). Listing: the region is all in page &1B (BEQ walked &1B33->&1B61, &1B45->&1B61, BCC &1B4F->&1B5B, BPL &1B55->&1B59 after the move): no branch gains or loses a page cross, branch distances only shrink. SKIP 1 after the RTS keeps get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses at &1B63 and everything after it in GAMEPLAY_ANY=0 builds; gameplay builds slide by 1 as the existing SKIP 12/13 padding there already does (accepted, decision 43). Baron: IF/SKIP/ENDIF as used two routines above. Bytes: 0 in the shipping build (1 in gameplay builds).
